purpose: Freeze the deterministic prospective Episode-start cohort rules for First60 without historical backfill or outcome-based selection.

semantics.first60_definition: The first 60 qualifying Episode-start observations after activation, ordered prospectively before outcomes are known.

activation.first_eligible_signal_date_rule: next joint SSE+SZSE A-share trading session after activation

episode_start_requires: canonical_security_id exists in the frozen V2.7.31 Certified Universe
signal timestamp is on or after the first eligible signal date
signal is generated only from information available at signal time under PIT rules
required Evidence chain is PASS or validly on-demand materialized under V2.7.30 when content is consumed
vendor/price coverage required by the Setup is PASS for that security and timestamp
episode start is committed to the candidate ledger before its outcome is observed

deterministic_order.note: Ordering is frozen before outcomes and cannot be rearranged later.

downstream.S4_S5_S6: remain blocked until First60 reaches a terminal evaluable state required by their own contracts
